derived_from_batch01_failure_shape.observed_failure_shape: batch01 showed a positive raw edge path but failed strict scoring because selected coverage stayed sparse and weak-context releases still leaked into the approval set
derived_from_batch01_failure_shape.refinement_reason: batch02 keeps the release-quality mechanism and adds an explicit context gate so the family only approves compression-release structures that are also supported by clean pre-expansion context rather than broadening or tuning thresholds

hypothesis_label: Compression release quality should improve only when combined with an explicit context gate before visible expansion

mechanism_contract.known_baseline_weakness: The primary baseline does not explicitly distinguish clean compression-release structures that occur in supportive pre-expansion context from superficially similar releases that appear in unstable context.
mechanism_contract.exact_mechanism_of_improvement: Introduce a composite pre-expansion approval state that requires both clean compression-release quality and a confirming context gate built from deterministic pre-expansion stability, trend-pass, and non-blocked structure evidence.
mechanism_contract.why_not_parameter_tuning: The refinement changes the approval mechanism by adding a new context-gated state definition; it is not a threshold-only or lookback-only retune of the batch01 family.
mechanism_contract.why_expected_edge_should_survive_strict_: If the refinement is real, it should improve strict scoring by removing weak-context release events and concentrating approvals in cleaner pre-expansion structures rather than by extracting a narrow calibration gain.

required_evidence_inputs: deterministic compression structure and release-cleanliness evidence available before expansion
deterministic context-gate evidence for pre-expansion trend pass, non-blocked structure, and stable readiness
overlay/context suitability evidence from phase68i_dynamic_ladder_candidate only when used as optional secondary context
allowed_scope: clean compression-release structure plus explicit pre-expansion context confirmation
new composite approval state before visible expansion
optional secondary compare against phase68i_dynamic_ladder_candidate for overlay/context suitability only
forbidden_scope: post-move trade management or leverage ladder changes
generic parameter-only tuning or random churn variants
